applicabilityBasis.summary: HKD-HSBC is the catalog entry for HSBC RedCoin, the forthcoming HKD fiat-referenced payment stablecoin of The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, licensed by HKMA and designed for 1:1 HKD redemption. It is separate from HSBC tokenized deposits.

genius.issuerEntity: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited
genius.notes: HSBC holds an HKMA stablecoin issuer licence for a planned HKD stablecoin, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration, or Treasury comparability determination was found. HSBC named the product HSBC RedCoin on September 30, 2026 and its current product page explicitly says no stablecoins have yet been issued in Hong Kong. Public disclosures describe future segregated liquid reserves and intended 1:1 redemption, but no issued-token reserve report, operative redemption policy or monthly report series was found. The existing false disclosure flags are retained on this basis. Bank-group status and HKMA licence FRS02 do not confer a U.S. GENIUS route on the exact Hong Kong issuer. DASP not-yet-restricted reflects GENIUS timing, not a finding of U.S. distribution or permission under other U.S. law.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS application, OCC foreign-issuer registration or Treasury comparability determination was located for The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited or HSBC RedCoin (catalog HKD-HSBC). The finding is limited to the opened public materials and exact-name searches; it does not establish that the issuer is ineligible or has no nonpublic application.
